svg.text: One data structure for every qualifying format in real racing. A suggestion for the Team Principal developers.
Today the game has two fixed formats: session_60 and knockout. This model keeps both as presets and adds the other 11.
Qualifying is a list of stages. A grid builder turns their results into one grid per race.
who takes part in each stage
minutes, max_laps, laps, km, tyre_sets, fuel, cut_every
one grid per race of the weekend
true: last stage fills the front
stage to use when a stage can't run (rain, time)
Take the preset, apply the season's fields, then the round's overrides.
Pick the entrants from earlier results, split groups, run it as its kind.
Apply the result rule. Store the full stage result.
stack, slices or from_race. Races 2 and 3 wait for the race before.
Reverse (drawn or fixed), interleave groups, penalties, retirements to the back.
Stage results feed qualifying points (B8), news and stats like "pole in Q4".
Stage kinds, and what the AI should do
Open track. Traffic, tyre and run plans, a banker lap, a late push.
Alone on track. One push lap or N laps, no traffic, in a set order.
A real race by laps or km. Finishing order is the result.
Two cars at a time in a bracket. Faster lap goes through.
No driving. Places from points, results or engine size.
Each lane is one real season. Coloured chips are stages, dark chips build the grid.
15 min · top 10 of P + top 2 of Q1
1 lap, reverse order · top 10 of Q
Oval runs, one car at a time
Grid by points or a formula
finish 50, owner pts 35, fast lap 15 · all
